required_decisions.decision: Use the existing AuditLog model with nullable tenantId plus an explicit TENANT or PLATFORM scope discriminator; tenant-targeted events retain the exact target tenant and platform-global events use null tenantId with PLATFORM scope.

Use targetId only for a real UUID target; for a non-UUID or platform-global target set targetId to null, retain targetType, and store a redacted stable target key in metadata without inventing a UUID or tenant.

Rollback the failed business transaction first, then persist the failure audit in an isolated audit transaction; if the audit store is unavailable, fail closed and use a separately durable retry channel outside the rolled-back business transaction before reporting a successful mutation outcome.
